name: ARMED FRAME
description:
About This Game

An action TPS & FPS game where you control a mech, speeding, flying, and fighting. The mech is customizable.

You can swap out 12 parts in total: head, torso, arms, legs, boosters, FCS, and 6 weapon parts.

Both the weapons and frame can be colored.

Actions include using weapons, jumping, ascending with boosters, wall climbing,

rapid boost (parallel, ascending, descending), rapid turn, and long boost.
short_desc: A fast-paced TPS & FPS where you control a mech in battle. Customize 12 parts: head, torso, arms, legs, booster, FCS, and 6 weapons. Weapon and frame colors are changeable. Use weapons, jump, boost up, run on walls, do rapid boosts, quick turns, and high boosts.
